description.value:
You sever a creature's binding to one of its existing contracts (a Kuchiyose contract, a curse-mark dependency, a Reaper Death Seal-style soul-bond, or similar magical obligation).

The target attempts a Will save. On a failure, attempt a counteract check against the contract's source rank using your spell rank and modifier. On a successful counteract, the contract is permanently broken; on failure, the seal flares uselessly.

This is the canonical jutsu Jiraiya used to break Orochimaru's snake contract on Anko.

system.requirements: willing target, OR unwilling restrained target
